design: Post-hoc diagnosis of the exact frozen 48 within-budget cases; original 80-case annotations unchanged. No live model or production edits.

variants.baseline: Unmodified real handler on all 80 cases; verify against published spans.
variants.soft: Real handler on all 80; override only insufficient_visible_match with >=1 body match and no missing exact/parent exact terms. Preserve all policy checks. No gold or case-specific rules in predicate.
variants.lexical_replay: All 48, same baseline projector inputs; existing generic lexical ordering only, unchanged qualification and budget.
variants.oracle_qualification: 15 misses; target witness range relevance supplied by gold only for original query, never unrelated intent rewrites. Preserve source-policy and exact checks.
variants.oracle_priority: 15 misses, fixed baseline projector inputs; witness-overlapping candidates first, qualification unchanged.
variants.oracle_window: 15 misses; replace baseline pack with real contiguous witness windows, same question and fresh original qualification; no foreign query coverage.
variants.oracle_window_qualification: Same windows, plus gold original-query relevance; retain exact and policy rejection.
variants.gold_dto: All 48; full actual witness spans and metadata serialized in ordinary retrieval-only DTO. Feasibility bound, not retrieval.

acceptance: Report frozen sufficiency, old sufficient losses, audit errors and full DTO budget separately. Manually assess the 15 without modifying frozen gold. A prototype succeeds only on final evidence, not intermediate recall. No tuning after seeing results.
